titles.romaji: Wo Cong Zhu Tian Wan Jie Guilai

description:
After three years in jail, he will emerge with the seven strongest bloodlines under heaven, twelve peak professional skills, thirty-six sets of supreme martial arts, seventy-two strongest mystical techniques, and 108 top-level chaos mantras! But with his maxed out martial powers, it turns out his spirit animal is a pig?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
